description.para: The following constants map to the XPAR parameters created in the xparameters.h file.
They are defined here such that a user can easily change all the needed parameters in one place.
The following buffers are used in this example to send and receive data with the UART.
The following counters are used to determine when the entire buffer has been sent and received.

briefdescription.para: Performs a minimal test on the UartPS device and driver.

detaileddescription.para: This function is a design example that illustrates how to use the XUartPs driver.
This function sends data and expects to receive the same data through the device using the local loopback mode.
This function uses interrupt mode of the device.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the instance of the UART driver which is going to be connected to the interrupt controller.

simplesect.para:
- In XSCT/classic flow, DeviceId is used to look up the device configuration.
This function contains an infinite loop such that if interrupts are not working it may never return.

briefdescription.para: Handles data events from the UART device in interrupt context.

detaileddescription.para: It is called from an interrupt context, so the amount of processing should be minimal.
This handler provides an example of how to handle data for the device and is application specific.

parameterdescription.para: Callback reference from the driver, in this case it is the instance pointer for the XUartPs driver.
Specific kind of event that has occurred.
Number of bytes sent or received for sent and receive events.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful, XST_FAILURE if unsuccessful.

briefdescription.para: Demonstrates the XUartPs driver in interrupt mode using local loopback.

detaileddescription.para: The example runs on the ZynqMP evaluation board (ZCU102). It sends data and expects to receive the same data through the device using the local loopback mode in interrupt mode by using the XUartPs driver.

The example contains an infinite loop such that if interrupts are not working it may hang. MODIFICATION HISTORY: Ver Who Date Changes
